title: Under the Tangerine Trees
description: Two women pick mexericas, or tangerines, from a tree in the village of Noiva do Cordeiro in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The rural community in southeast Brazil consists of about 350 people, and women have helped shape it for more than two centuries. It is common for both men and women in the village to participate in manual labor, and harvesting mexericas helps bring in income for the residents.
translated_description: 在巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州诺伊瓦-杜科代鲁村，两名妇女正从树上采摘墨西哥柑橘（即蜜橘）。这个位于巴西东南部的乡村社区约有350人，两百多年来，女性一直在塑造着这里。在村里，男女共同参与体力劳动是常态，而采摘墨西哥柑橘也为居民带来了收入。
